## Change and purpose

Adds one `incoming/` packet, `incoming/claude-01cz-recovery-index-20261013/` (three text files: `IDENTITY.json`, `RESULT.md`, `RECOVERY_INDEX.json`), registering through the existing delivery procedure where this session's preserved scratch work lives. It answers the owner's recovery request on main #307 ([6136156988](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/issues/307#issuecomment-6136156988), [6136210973](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/issues/307#issuecomment-6136210973)) under the implementation decision [6136231457](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/issues/307#issuecomment-6136231457) ("register each checkpoint once through the existing delivery procedure, with a per-file manifest"). A reader can find, by commit and digest, every still-local artifact of this session (renderer versions 1–9, binders of rounds 1–14 with logs, the round-4 triage probes, proof-packet round 5–6 verification files, the main #151 museum review probes, the torus companion work, notes) before re-deriving any of it. Scope: engineering (byte custody and indexing); scientific effect NONE.

## Current disposition

- Claim / handoff: recovery delivery [307/6136367558](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/issues/307#issuecomment-6136367558); no scientific claim.
- Successor of: none; retained stops: none; unavailable artifacts: repository/tree copies and Lean build caches were deliberately not copied (reproducible; listed in the reading copy's `EXCLUDED.json`).
- Completed review scopes and source identities: one bounded engineering read, **PASS_ENGINEERING_SCOPED** at `d1cd7d07` by Anthropic Claude session `session_017Mi3hxjaxV45x6zo6o1ee3` ([386/6151097039](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/pull/386#issuecomment-6151097039), under the coordinator's activation [386/6150827473](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/pull/386#issuecomment-6150827473)); scope: the three index and custody files, every pin, manifest count and digest, the retention terms; same provider, organizational-independence credit 0; not provider-distinct credit, not a merge qualification, no payload executed.
- **Scope qualification (O1 of that read, retained as asked in [386/6151500065](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/pull/386#issuecomment-6151500065)):** this index is accurate for its own pin `ee7491ba` and claims nothing later. The recovery branch has since moved additively to `c4fc0a2c` (18 commits; under `recovery/session_01Cz7WZybv8znP64SpPj6sWY/` 233 files added and 4 modified, `EXCLUDED.json`, `MANIFEST.json`, `README.md` and one scratch PR-body draft; nothing deleted or rewritten; recounted by the author with `git diff --name-status ee7491ba c4fc0a2c`). Those later checkpoints are described by that branch's own `MANIFEST.json` (per-file SHA-256) and `README.md` checkpoint sections, not by this index. An index update to a later pin is not activated and not started. O2 (a session-independent truncated scratch-root prefix in four `replay_mem_samples.txt` files marked `scrubbed: true`) is noted; nothing session-specific.
- Unresolved finding IDs and next action: none blocking; hosted checks green on `d1cd7d07`; the PR is `behind`; next action is a distinct integrator named by the coordinator. The author does not mark ready or merge.

- The five `IDENTITY.json` sources are the three files above at `ee7491ba` and the handoff reading copy's `MANIFEST.json` / `README.md` at `b88efe53` (verified by the recipient at [358/6135548452](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/pull/358#issuecomment-6135548452) and by the coordinator at [307/6136189870](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/issues/307#issuecomment-6136189870)); each pinned by full commit and SHA-256 of the exact bytes, all reachable from branches of this public repository.
- Both artifacts' byte counts and SHA-256 recomputed from the committed bytes; strict JSON (no floats) in both JSON files. The hosted `public-intake` check (pull_request_target, trusted default-branch checker) on head `d1cd7d07`: check run 115094237546 **success** (its duplicate 115094022905 and the earlier run on `2131e5ff` were cancelled by the platform, no verdict); `formal / formal-evidence`, `public-shop`, `browser-smoke` and `architecture / research-architecture` all success on this head. Latest payload checkpoint on the retained branch: commit `097d9450e871a92f29c499d0f0ab95743dc090b5` (checkpoint 2: +39 files, manifests regenerated; same location), a further commit after the pinned `ee7491ba`, as the packet's retention statement provides.

## Evidence and limits

Byte custody and indexing only: nothing here is a receipt, a review verdict or evidence about any mathematical claim; no claim, Prop or packet label changes; the reading copies hold scratch (candidates, probes, mutants, logs, drafts, failed attempts). Authorship and exposure: the same session that produced the material; organizational-independence credit 0. Retention is explicit (per [307/6136476552](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/issues/307#issuecomment-6136476552)): the payload branch and commit are retained while any required work relies on them, until a verified durable replacement contains the actual bytes and this index is updated; an index alone is not a replacement backup; no deletion is requested. The handoff reading copy stays at its verified commit `b88efe53` under the same retention. Canonical evidence record: the reading copy's `README.md` and `MANIFEST.json` at `ee7491ba`.
